sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, secured another impressive win on Saturday with a 2-0 victory over Eccleshall at home. They have no further fixtures listed for the coming week beyond their match against Eccleshall that has already been played.
divisionWide: Several significant results unfolded across the division on Saturday. Allscott Heath (11th) delivered a dominant 4-1 away performance against bottom-placed Alsager Town, continuing their recent upturn in form. Barnton (7th) secured a valuable 2-0 away win at struggling Telford Town, extending their unbeaten league run. Bilston Town (6th) thrashed Market Drayton Town 3-0 at home despite the visitors being reduced to ten men early on. Wednesfield Community (9th) claimed their first clean sheet of the season with a 1-0 away victory at Crewe (16th), while Brereton Social (14th) upset AFC Bridgnorth (3rd) with a narrow 1-0 home win—a significant result given Bridgnorth's position. Wolverhampton Casuals (4th) cruised to a 3-1 away win over Shawbury United (15th), and Stafford Town (2nd) drew 3-3 with Cheadle Heath Nomads (17th) despite going down to ten men. Finally, Dawley Town (12th) secured a crucial 2-1 away victory at New Mills (8th), while New Mills fell to defeat. All Saturday's fixtures have now been completed; no further matches are scheduled for the coming week.
